Description
The University of Dayton is a private Roman Catholic research university in Dayton, Ohio and was founded in 1850. The university's campus is in the city's southern portion and spans 388 acres on both sides of the Great Miami River.
In U.S. News & World Report 's 2020 ranking of national universities, University of Dayton is tied for 132nd overall and 58th for "best value" in the U.S
